newsitem.title: USA: Unitrode sets special vote on share increase.
newsitem.headline: Unitrode sets special vote on share increase.

text.p: Unitrode Corp on Tuesday said it called a special meeting on September 2 to vote on a proposal to raise the number of authorized common shares to 100 million ahead of a planned stock split.
Currently there are 30 million common shares authorized.
The company said stockholders of record as of August 25 will be entitled to vote at the meeting, and the split, in the form of a 100 percent dividend, will be payable October 6.
Unitrode had about 11.7 million common shares outstanding on May 3, out of 30 million shares authorized for issuance.
Unitrode designs and manufactures analog/linear integrated circuits, principally to perform power management, motion control, and interface functions.
